title: Trapped in Karakol
text:
**Grace’s corner** Rushan and me have both been unwell, which means we have spent 5 days in Karakol. Don’t get me wrong, it is a nice little town but is mainly used as a base for hiking with limited sights to see. As such, we wake up everyday, don’t feel well enough and book another night here. 

We also celebrated 8 years together and went to a hot spring (not pictured) 🥳
